title.zh: 小模型不可信，守卫必须是代码
title.en: Distrust the Model, Encode the Guard

summary.zh: 本地 3B 模型写代码，问题不是笨，是不可靠。Local Ollama Harness 把每一种失败模式都变成了守卫里的一条确定性规则：模型只负责提议，裁决权在 harness。
summary.en: A local 3B model isn't dumb — it's unreliable. Local Ollama Harness turns every known failure mode into a deterministic guard rule: the model proposes, the harness disposes.

title.zh: 为什么我不做 Agent，而做一层 Runtime
title.en: Why a Runtime, Not Another Agent Framework

summary.zh: 每个 agent 框架最终都会撞上同一堵墙。Intent OS 的回答是：不做第八十个框架，做框架之上的那层确定性——意图编译成带验收标准的计划，副作用过审批闸门，回执进哈希链。
summary.en: Every agent harness hits the same wall. Intent OS answers by not being the 80th framework: compile intent into plans with acceptance criteria, gate side effects, and hash-chain the receipts.

title.zh: 把 Milkdown 塞进 WebView：混血编辑器的取舍
title.en: Milkdown in a WebView: Trade-offs of a Hybrid Editor

summary.zh: Flutter 做壳，WebView 里跑 Milkdown，中间靠一个 JS 桥说话——这不是偷懒，是明确的取舍。单一桥协议、SAF URI 持久化、手写 OOXML、主题单向流，四个决定及其代价。
summary.en: A Flutter shell, Milkdown in a WebView, one JS bridge between them — a deliberate trade, not a shortcut. One bridge protocol, persisted SAF URIs, hand-rolled OOXML, one-way theming.

title.zh: 给一个不太可信的模型造笼子
title.en: A Cage for One Untrusted Model

summary.zh: 代码管必然，人管例外，模型管灰区——三层防线锁住 Claude Code 里那个不太靠谱的模型，而且只锁它一个：换任何别的模型，这套笼子零开销。
summary.en: Code handles the certain, humans handle the exceptions, a model handles the gray zone — three layers lock down one untrusted model in Claude Code, and only that one: any other model runs at zero cost.
